Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · retells · "As I write I may end up discarding one form of an essay, and then taking parts of it to create another." (Essays begin as a boundary of notes; conversation stays separate from the records that emerge (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "I'll duplicate a paragraph and work with multiple versions of it, changing order to see what works." (An essay is a container for meaning that grows from exploration to argument; essays form families (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-29 · retells · "In a complex essay, I need to be able to switch paragraphs in antd out to see how they flow." (Essay editor: draft paragraphs cannot be reviewed without restoring them (2026-10-29))
- 2026-10-29 · touches · "assist in writing carefully researched funding bids" (The essay editor needs word and character counts for funding bids (2026-10-29))
- 2026-11-10 · touches · "I need a clean way to navigate between essays with shared paraphraphs." (I cannot see where a shared paragraph came from, or what a note or reference says, without leaving the essay (2026-11-10))
